subject: Request: approval for 3 runtime/infra hires + comp bands
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: approval for 3 runtime/infra hires + comp bands

Team —

Following up from last week’s planning session: the runtime/infra roadmap requires three priority hires to meet Q3 throughput and reliability targets. Summary below; full packet attached (runtime-hc-brief.pdf, comp-band-2026.csv).

1) Senior Runtime SWE (backend-heavy, latency optimizations) — 1 headcount. Target band: L4–L5, comp-range "$220–260k total comp" (base+bonus+equity).
2) Infra Reliability SWE (SRE focus for serving runtime) — 1 headcount. Target band: L4, comp-range "$200–230k".
3) Platform Performance Engineer (profiling, kernels, infra tooling) — 1 headcount. Target band: L3–L4, comp-range "$170–210k".

Rationale: current team operating at >85% utilization for realtime pools; upcoming model rollouts will add sustained load and the prefix/KV cache initiative needs dedicated ownership. If we don’t add these roles, we risk a 12–18% regression in p99 latency or we must accept slower rollout cadence.

Asks: headcount approval for 3 FTEs (Q3 starts), authorization to offer up to the top of listed bands for critical candidates, and permission to convert one contractor (infra support) if we can't close the SRE role by Aug 1.

Attachments: [attachment: runtime-hc-brief.pdf (application/pdf)], [attachment: comp-band-2026.csv (text/csv)].

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Staff Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approval for 3 runtime/infra hires + comp bands

Jonas —

Thanks for the packet, I scanned the traffic projections and they make sense. Two clarifying Qs before I take to finance:
- For the \"authorization to offer up to the top of listed bands\": can you flag which role(s) you expect to need the top-of-band immediately?
- If we convert the contractor, what’s the 90-day ramp impact and cost delta?

If you can send a 1-paragraph short justification for each role and the proposed timeline for ramp (start date + 30/60/90 milestones), I’ll draft the hiring request for Finance.

—Marissa
Director, Engineering Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approval for 3 runtime/infra hires + comp bands

Marissa —

Short justifications below (you can paste into the Finance form):

1) Senior Runtime SWE — Key to lowering p99 for streaming generation by ~15% via kernel-level optimizations and improved batching. Ramp: start-week 1 onboard tools + infra (30d), implement targeted micro-optimizations (60d), shipping 1st perf regressed fix (90d). Top-of-band authorization recommended for exceptional kernel candidates.

2) Infra Reliability SWE — Prevent production incidents during scale; will own SLO experiments, alerting, and incident postmortems. Ramp: 30/60/90 milestones focusing on runbooks, playbook automation, and testbed load generation. Top-of-band only if candidate is a direct hire from high-risk operational environments (large-scale inference infra experience).

3) Platform Performance Engineer — Instrumentation, profiling dashboards, and micro-bench harnesses to expose per-model cost. Ramp: 30/60/90 (instrumentation -> dashboards -> optimization roadmap). Mid-band expected; top-band not usually required.

Contractor conversion: current contractor (infra-support) does ~30% of the SRE backlog. Conversion delta = +10% on benefits/bonus -> overall ~8% increase relative to contractor cost but with faster ramp. If hires delayed, I'll ask for 3-month extension on contractor budget to avoid gaps.

I’ve attached Sofia Rivera’s resume — a strong candidate for the Senior Runtime opening (sofia_resume.pdf). Nathan at TalentSearch thinks she’ll want mid-to-high band.

Jonas
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-31T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approval for 3 runtime/infra hires + comp bands

Thanks Jonas — couple of operational asks before I greenlight the headcount:
1) Prioritization: confirm which of the three is critical to ship the KV cache initiative by end of Q3.
2) Contingency: if we use top-of-band offers, how does this impact our recruiting budget for Q4?

On prioritization: the Senior Runtime and Platform Performance roles are the highest priority for KV cache work. If we can only hire two by July 1, make them those two.

On budget: Marissa, please model the delta for us (I want to see Q3 vs Q4 spend). If the numbers are reasonable I’m fine authorizing up to the top-of-band for one hire (Senior Runtime) given the immediate risk to SLAs.

—Vivek
Head of Infra & Runtime
Redwood Inference
